notes.title: Bug fixes, head bob toggle, and more!
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added preset options, choose from the original experience or the Fancy edition.
[*]Added a head bob toggle. Head bobbing is disabled by default in the Fancy preset.
[*]Added an option to auto equip the pistol when starting the first level. It is enabled by default in the Fancy preset.
[*]Adjusted mouse settings to be more sensitive.
[*]Fixed cutscenes not proceeding (after the red text). Previously you had to press the reload key, now you can press anything except escape, which skips the cutscene entirely.
[*]Fixed analog stick glyphs not showing up for Steam and PlayStation Controllers in the remapper.
[*]Minor visual adjustments to the launcher.
[/list]
Note: This update will reset your settings.

notes.title: 1994 retro shooter The Fortress of Dr. Radiaki gets a Fancy Edition re-release out now
notes.content:
A blast from the past, although not too well-known. Originally from Maelstrom Software and Future Visionary, The Fortress of Dr. Radiaki - Fancy Edition is a fresh upgraded re-release of the 1994 game from ZOOM Platform Media that's out now.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/05/1994-retro-shooter-the-fortress-of-dr-radiaki-gets-a-fancy-edition-re-release-out-now/

notes.title: Retro FPS classic The Fortress of Dr. Radiaki is coming to Steam with an enhanced edition
notes.content:
The Fortress of Dr. Radiaki originally released back in 1994 and it's getting a little revival thanks to ZOOM Platform Media / Lee Jacobson with a Steam release due out in May.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/04/retro-fps-classic-the-fortress-of-dr-radiaki-is-coming-to-steam-with-an-enhanced-edition/
